Question Explanation
The question is asking for the number of bivalents in prophase I of meiosis if each daughter cell after meiosis has 8 chromosomes.

Concept
prophase I 

Solution
Each daughter cell has 8 chromosomes, meaning the haploid number (n) is 8. In prophase I, homologous chromosomes pair up to form bivalents. Therefore, the number of bivalents in the mother cell will be equal to the haploid number, which is 8.
